meta.title: Andrea Alfonzo — Aerialist and dancer | Hair hanging, aerial lyra and silks
meta.description: Andrea Alfonzo is an aerialist and dancer based in Buenos Aires, specialising in hair hanging, aerial lyra and silks, available for international work.
meta.keywords: aerialist, hair hanging, aerial lyra, aerial silks, aerial drop straps, circus artist Argentina, aerialist for hire

hero.name: Andrea Belén Alfonzo
hero.location: Buenos Aires, Argentina · Available to travel

about.title: About
paragraphs: I am a professional circus artist, aerialist and dancer, passionate about movement, performance and bodily expression. My work combines flexibility, strength, elegance and delicacy, seeking to create performances that captivate the audience.

I consider myself a committed, versatile and dedicated artist, with a constant desire to keep learning, growing and gaining new experiences, developing professionally as part of companies, shows and artistic projects both in Argentina and abroad, bringing creativity, professionalism and commitment to every opportunity.

disciplines.title: Aerial disciplines

hairHanging.name: Hair hanging
hairHanging.description: A combination of fast spins and speed. Suspended from her hair, she flies with delicacy and serenity, weaving contortion and flexibility shapes into a blend of fluid dance.

aerialLyra.name: Aerial lyra
aerialLyra.description: A fusion of dance, flexibility and strength on an aerial hoop, metres above the ground, where elegance, passion and delicacy turn into movement.

aerialDrop.name: Aerial drop straps
aerialDrop.description: A sensual, provocative aerial act combining dance and acrobatics. A bold, sophisticated proposal, ideal for night shows, cabaret and events looking for an intense, captivating staging.

aerialSilks.name: Aerial silks
aerialSilks.description: An act of character and intensity combining dynamic climbs, shapes and wraps at height, drops and risk moves. A proposal of strength, speed and control that keeps the audience on edge.

disciplines.other: Versatility and adaptation to different aerial techniques and apparatus, according to the needs and characteristics of each show.
